# tree

Display directory trees as text, JSON or HTML through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/tree -L 2 .

moonx cli/tree -J --noreport .
```

Walk directory entries with optional depth, pattern and pruning rules. Symbolic links appear as named leaves.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--all` | Include hidden entries. |
| `-d`, `--dirs-only` | List directories only. |
| `-L VALUE`, `--level VALUE` | Limit depth. |
| `-J`, `--json` | Write JSON output. |
| `-P VALUE`, `--pattern VALUE` | Include files matching a pattern. |
| `-I VALUE`, `--ignore VALUE` | Exclude matching names and subtrees. |
| `--prune` | Omit directories left empty by filtering. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Link-target display and mode-based colors are unavailable. Selected size operations on links reject explicitly; directory-size behavior depends on the platform.
- Color must be selected explicitly when needed.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
